meta.title: Events and ticketing: tickets, tables and the gate · Clafina
meta.description: Ticket types, seating plans, door sales and a gate that lets each ticket in once. The Events pack for Clafina, on the same invoices and customers.

hero.title: Sell every ticket once, and let every ticket in once.
hero.lede: Ticket types, tables and sessions, a gate that gives the reason when it refuses, and the event's takings on one page.

business.name: Zamani Events
business.about: An events company running the two-day Abuja Home and Living Fair, with talks, a workshop and a gala dinner.

dayTitle: Day one of the fair, with Zamani Events

moments.title: How the fair was set up
moments.problem: Weeks ago, before a single ticket was sold, the fair needed its tickets, its sessions and its gala tables.
moments.handles: Hadiza made it as a draft, with ticket types that each have a price, a number, a sales window and a limit per order, and sessions with a room and a time. It could not go on sale until every gala table was drawn on the plan.

moments.title: The gate opens and the queue is long
moments.problem: Hundreds of visitors are waiting, and some tickets are not what they seem.
moments.handles: Staff scan each ticket's QR code or type its number. A code that is forged, for another event, not paid or already used is refused with the reason, and every scan is recorded.

moments.title: Into the opening talk
moments.problem: Visitors with a talk on their ticket head for the main hall.
moments.handles: A session scan is separate from the gate. A ticket gets into each session it admits to, once.

moments.title: A company buys twenty passes on account
moments.problem: Gurara Builders wants passes for its staff for tomorrow, and will pay by invoice.
moments.handles: The sale makes an invoice through the usual invoice path. The tickets read not paid yet at the gate until it is paid, then become valid and are emailed.

moments.title: People turn up without tickets
moments.problem: A family arrives at the gate, wanting to buy there and then.
moments.handles: Door sales use the same sale as every other ticket, paid in cash or by card and recorded at the door. The count of tickets left goes down at once.

moments.title: Two buyers want the last gala table
moments.problem: One gala table is left, and two people ask for it within a minute of each other.
moments.handles: The table is held for a few minutes for the first buyer while she pays. The second is refused, and told which table it was. Two sales can never take the last ticket or table.

moments.title: A buyer cannot come
moments.problem: A visitor who bought a two-day pass has been called away and asks for her money back.
moments.handles: Within the refund window it is free; after it, a reason is asked for. The tickets are voided, the count goes back and the refund names the invoice to credit. A ticket already scanned in is never refunded.

moments.title: What did day one bring in?
moments.problem: Before the gala, the team wants the day's figures.
moments.handles: The event page shows tickets by type, the gate's figures, sales by day, and what each sponsor agreed and has paid.

modulesTitle: The parts of Clafina an events business uses

faq.q: Can two people buy the last ticket?
faq.a: No. Every sale claims its tickets first, so the last ticket or table goes to one buyer. A sale that is tried twice counts once.

faq.q: What stops a ticket being used twice?
faq.a: Each ticket gets in once. If two desks scan the same ticket, only the first lets it in, and the second is refused with the reason.

faq.q: Can a company pay by invoice?
faq.a: Yes. The sale makes an invoice, and the tickets become valid and are emailed when it is paid.

faq.q: Can we sell at the door?
faq.a: Yes. Door sales use the same sale, paid in cash or by card and recorded.
Free within the refund window you set, and with a reason after it. A ticket already scanned in cannot be refunded.

faq.q: Does the gate keep scanning if the network drops?
faq.a: Yes. Staff can scan tickets at the gate with no network.
